quarterly_data.signal: Meta's 10-Q: as of June 30, 2026 Meta had $349.31 billion of non-cancelable contractual commitments, short- and long-term, most of which relate to third-party cloud capacity arrangements and other investments in technical infrastructure; some of its partnerships include multi-year purchase commitments and it continues to enter into additional significant contractual arrangements. In connection with escrow requirements under certain multi-year infrastructure purchase agreements, $10.80 billion of money market funds was reclassified as restricted cash equivalents, expected to be released between 2028 and 2030 as the underlying purchase obligations are satisfied.
quarterly_data.figure: $349.31 billion non-cancelable contractual commitments (June 30, 2026); $10.80 billion escrowed for multi-year infrastructure purchase agreements (release 2028-2030)
